_comment: Player texts for Oracle of Sevens. Numbers are {placeholders} filled from game.json and the published math (tools/gen/gen_rules.py, M9), never typed here. Social casino wording is applied by the core (wording.ts).
game.name: ORACLE OF SEVENS
mode.base.title: FATE: VEIL
mode.base.label: Fate: Veil
mode.base.dialog: Standard play. Bonus about 1 in {mode.base.bonusOneIn} spins. Every winning spin pays more than the bet. {mode.base.rtpText}
mode.omen.title: FATE: OMEN
mode.omen.label: Fate: Omen
mode.omen.dialog: Price {mode.omen.cost}x per spin. Bonus about 1 in {mode.omen.bonusOneIn} spins instead of 1 in {mode.base.bonusOneIn}. Nearly every win pays more than the spin price. {mode.omen.rtpText}
mode.prophecy.title: FATE: PROPHECY
mode.prophecy.label: Fate: Prophecy
mode.prophecy.dialog: Price {mode.prophecy.cost}x per spin. Bonus about 1 in {mode.prophecy.bonusOneIn} spins. Many wins return less than the spin price. {mode.prophecy.rtpText}
mode.star.title: STAR BONUS
mode.star.label: Star Bonus (buy)
mode.star.dialog: {variant.star.spinsMin}-{variant.star.spinsMax} free spins. Starts with {variant.star.prechargeSpots} spots charged at x{variant.star.prechargeValue}; sigils persist for the whole bonus. Can pay less than its price. {mode.star.rtpText}
mode.tower.title: TOWER BONUS
mode.tower.label: Tower Bonus (buy)
mode.tower.dialog: {variant.tower.spinsMin}-{variant.tower.spinsMax} free spins. Starts with {variant.tower.prechargeSpots} spots charged at x{variant.tower.prechargeValue}. Can pay less than its price. {mode.tower.rtpText}
rules.scatter: Crystal Ball (scatter): {variant.star.scatterMin}-{variant.star.scatterMax} start the Star Bonus, {variant.tower.scatterMin} or more start the Tower Bonus.
rules.minPay: In Fate: Veil the smallest pay is {paytable.minPay}x, so every winning spin pays more than the bet.
rules.charged.title: Charged grid
rules.charged: A win on an empty spot marks it with a sigil. A win on a marked spot charges it to x2. Each later win on that spot doubles it: {grid.steps}, up to x{grid.cap}. A cluster's pay is multiplied by the sum of the charged spots under it. In the base game the grid clears after each spin.
rules.bonuses.title: Bonuses
rules.bonuses: Star Bonus: {variant.star.spinsMin} free spins ({variant.star.scatterMin} Crystal Balls) or {variant.star.spinsMax} ({variant.star.scatterMax} Crystal Balls), starting with {variant.star.prechargeSpots} spots already charged at x{variant.star.prechargeValue}. Tower Bonus: {variant.tower.spinsMin}-{variant.tower.spinsMax} free spins, starting with {variant.tower.prechargeSpots} spots already charged at x{variant.tower.prechargeValue}. In both bonuses the grid persists for the whole bonus. {retrigger.min} or more Crystal Balls during a bonus add {retrigger.spins} spins.
button.buyBonus: Opens the Fate modes (Omen, Prophecy) and the Star and Tower bonus buys, with price, RTP and max win.
rules.modes: Fate: Omen and Fate: Prophecy raise the price of each spin in exchange for more frequent bonuses. In Fate: Omen nearly every win pays more than the spin price. In Fate: Prophecy many wins return less than the spin price; its value comes mostly from the bonuses. RTP is the same in every mode.
